# pihole_dns_blocking (Data Source)

Reads PiHole's current global DNS blocking state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current DNS blocking state.
data "pihole_dns_blocking" "current" {}

output "blocking_enabled" {
  value = data.pihole_dns_blocking.current.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether DNS blocking is currently enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `timer` (Number) Seconds remaining until blocking reverts to its previous state, or null if no timer is active.
